release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.0

• **Fixed Official Music Video Playback (Windows & Android)**: Restored InnerTube session resolution (1080p/720p HLS on Android and instant native MP4 playback on Windows), wired Home's Music Videos shelf into Video mode, and fixed audio handoff on close.
• **HoloDeck 3D, Pixel Shift & Live Motion Covers Everywhere**: Enabled 3D gyroscope/mouse tilt, Pixel Shift tile transitions, and Live Animated Cover Art across default Immersive, Minimalist Focus, Framed, and Cinematic Now Playing modes.
• **Fixed Live Motion Cover Providers**: Restored Apple Music motion artwork and Community Canvas track matching.
• **Mobile MiniPlayer Swipe-Up Restored**: Swipe up on the mobile mini-player to expand Now Playing smoothly.
